original_contribution: Corrected operational decision guide and independently tested Python wiring with business-field validation, durable downstream-key handoff, payload mismatch behavior and explicit post-effect failure/expiry boundaries.

delivery_contract.format: UTF-8 Markdown including complete Python example

validation_contract.scope: Actual Powertools decorator and DynamoDB persistence adapter with deterministic fake I/O. No AWS deployment, network calls, payment processor or external exactly-once guarantee.

supported_boundary: Guidance and tested Python 3.12/Powertools 3.36.0 wiring for a single decoded JSON payment event per Lambda invocation and an existing DynamoDB persistence table. Requires a buyer-supplied payment function with durable downstream idempotency. Does not implement a payment processor, cross-service atomicity, authentication, SQS batch handling, AWS deployment or other language adapters.
